MATCH (i:Issue)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(pp:Person) WITH i, pp.personKey AS a
MATCH (i)-[:IN_PROJECT]->(pr:Project)
WITH collect(i.issueKey) AS ks
MATCH p=(x:Issue)-[rs:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]-(y:Issue)
WHERE all(n IN nodes(p) WHERE n.issueKey IN ks) AND size(nodes(p))=size(apoc.coll.toSet(nodes(p)))
RETURN count(p)

MATCH p=(x:Issue)-[rs:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION*1..5]-(y:Issue)
WHERE all(r IN rs WHERE EXISTS{(startNode(r))-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u)} AND EXISTS{(endNode(r))-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v)} AND NOT EXISTS{(startNode(r))-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u:Person)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO]-(endNode(r))})
WITH p, nodes(p) AS ns, rs, x, y
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-2) WHERE NOT ns[i] IN ns[i+1..]) AND x.issueKey < y.issueKey
AND NOT EXISTS{ (y)-[r2:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]-(z:Issue) WHERE NOT z IN ns AND EXISTS{(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u)} AND EXISTS{(z)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v)} AND NOT EXISTS{(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO]-(z)} }
AND NOT EXISTS{ (x)-[r2:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]-(z:Issue) WHERE NOT z IN ns AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(u)} AND EXISTS{(z)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(v)} AND NOT EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO]-(z)} }
RETURN [n IN ns | n.issueKey] AS path, [r IN rs | r.linkId] AS links, size(rs) AS hops

MATCH p=(x:Issue) ((a:Issue)-[r:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]-(b:Issue) WHERE EXISTS{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)} AND EXISTS{(b)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)} AND NOT EXISTS{(a)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO]-(b)}){1,5} (y:Issue)
WITH p, nodes(p) AS ns, relationships(p) AS rs, x, y
WHERE all(i IN range(0,size(ns)-2) WHERE NOT ns[i] IN ns[i+1..]) AND x.issueKey < y.issueKey
AND NOT EXISTS{ (y)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]-(z:Issue) WHERE NOT z IN ns AND EXISTS{(z)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)} AND EXISTS{(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)} AND NOT EXISTS{(y)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO]-(z)} }
AND NOT EXISTS{ (x)-[:BLOCKER|BONFIRE_TESTING|CAUSE|CLONERS|DEPENDS|DERIVED|DETAIL|DUPLICATE|FOLLOWS|PART|REFERENCE|REGRESSION|RELATE|RELATED|RESOLVE|SPLIT|SUPERSESSION]-(z:Issue) WHERE NOT z IN ns AND EXISTS{(z)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)} AND EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)} AND NOT EXISTS{(x)-[:ASSIGNED_TO]->(:Person)<-[:ASSIGNED_TO]-(z)} }
UNWIND range(0,size(rs)-1) AS k
RETURN [n IN ns | n.issueKey] AS path, ns[k].issueKey AS issue, rs[k].linkId AS link, size(rs) AS hops
